description: Defines the NetworkInterfaceCache class for managing network interface information on Fuchsia OS, including methods for adding, changing, removing interfaces, and retrieving network state information. It handles thread safety and error states.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of network interfaces on Fuchsia, supporting thread-safe access, modification, and error handling.

methods.name: AddInterfaces
methods.description: Adds multiple network interfaces to the cache; returns nullopt if any addition fails.

methods.name: AddInterface
methods.description: Adds a single network interface; returns nullopt if invalid or duplicate.

methods.name: ChangeInterface
methods.description: Updates an existing interface; returns nullopt if invalid or not found.

methods.name: RemoveInterface
methods.description: Removes an interface by ID; returns nullopt if not found.

methods.name: SetError
methods.description: Sets the cache to an unrecoverable error state.

methods.name: GetOnlineInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of online network interfaces, ignoring loopback; returns false if in error state.

methods.name: GetConnectionType
methods.description: Returns current network connection type, or CONNECTION_UNKNOWN if in error state.
